error_reason: Despite explicit instructions to open NCBI Genome Browse (https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genome/browse/) and search there for beluga whale/Delphinapterus leucas, the agent performed a generic Bing search with an overconstrained query. This diverted the workflow away from the required NCBI/Ensembl repositories, leading to irrelevant navigation (e.g., GDV) and preventing discovery of the correct GFF3 link and timestamp. Correctly following the site-specific navigation at this earliest point would have led to the proper assembly/FTP pages and avoided the wrong answer.

hypotheses.rationale: Instead of opening the specified NCBI Genome browse page and searching within it as instructed in step 37/41, the agent performed a generic Bing search with an overconstrained query. This diverted the workflow away from the target repositories/indices (NCBI/Ensembl) where GFF3 download links or FTP archives would be found, causing subsequent navigation to irrelevant pages (e.g., GDV) and ultimately leading to the incorrect final answer. Had the agent followed the instruction to open the NCBI genome browse page and search for Delphinapterus leucas within that site, they likely would have reached assembly pages or FTP directories exposing proper GFF3 links and been able to check timestamps relative to 20/10/2020.
hypotheses.check: Compare step 37/41 instructions (navigate directly to https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genome/browse/ and search within the site) against step 39’s action (a Bing query). Verify that step 39 deviated from the required in-site navigation and that this deviation led to the later focus on GDV (steps 43, 47) and absence of any GFF3 download link discovery.

evidence.discrepancy: Instruction in Step 37 required opening https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genome/browse/ and searching within that site. Step 39 instead performed a generic Bing search for a long query, diverting from the specified in-site navigation. This led to clicking GDV (Step 43) and remaining within GDV (Step 47), where no GFF3 download links were found, culminating in an incorrect final answer.
